latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Caption Generator DaVinci

- Add captions to DaVinci Resolve video exports using an automated cloud-based pipeline.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV files up to 500MB; outputs 1080p MP4 with auto-synced captions.
- Handles uploads, credit tracking, export/downloads, and session management via cloud API.
- Users can interact via chat to upload video, add captions, check credits, and export results.
- Jobs process on GPU (typically 30–90 seconds); exports ready for download.
- Automatic setup: free tokens available for new users, session creation handled transparently.
